## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Important defect needs fixing. The new `adopt` branch never checks whether the incoming value differs from the current one, so a no-op adoption still reports a change and rewrites the user's config file. This review read the full diff, `app/config.py`, and `tests/test_config.py` at the PR head; it read the tests but did not run them. The `replace` path still skips unchanged values: `test_unchanged_replacement_preserves_bytes` covers that case, and `test_replace_updates_different_setting` covers the changed-value case.

## Changes
The PR adds an `adopt` keyword to `merge` in `app/config.py`. When `adopt` is set, every incoming key that already exists is overwritten and added to the change list, and `replace` keeps its existing only-if-different behaviour. It also adds two tests: one for adopting a different value and one for replacing a different value.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:13 — correctness — Skip unchanged values in the adopt branch — Calling `merge(path, {"theme": "dark"}, adopt=True)` on a file containing `{"theme":"dark"}\n` returns `["theme"]` and rewrites the file as `{\n  "theme": "dark"\n}\n`, even though no value changed. Lines 13–15 assign and append without the `current[key] != value` check that the `replace` branch uses at line 19, and line 22 writes whenever `changes` is non-empty. Because `adopt` is tested before `replace`, passing both flags also loses the unchanged-value guard. — Your module docstring promises "preserving untouched configuration files", and `test_unchanged_replacement_preserves_bytes` enforces that for `replace`. With `adopt`, an untouched file is reformatted on every call and callers are told a key changed when it did not; no test covers adopting an equal value. — Fix: Wrap lines 14–15 in `if current[key] != value:` to match the `replace` branch. If adopted keys must be listed even when the value is equal, track them apart from the list that decides the write at line 22, so an unchanged file is not rewritten.
